svg.title: 10-year yield minus 2-year yield
svg.desc: Computed 10-year minus 2-year Treasury spread, Oct 2016 to 2026-10-29. Ends at 0.37 percentage points.
svg.text: Computed from FRED DGS10 and DGS2. Not a separate published series.
